title: Syrian Lentil Wrap
description: A hearty and flavorful wrap filled with spicy lentil mixture, perfect for a quick and healthy meal.
instructions: In a large pan, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the cumin, coriander, and paprika, and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the crushed tomato paste and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the rinsed and drained red lentils, salt, and black pepper.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
Warm the nourishing wrap by wrapping it in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Spoon the lentil mixture onto the center of the wrap, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the bottom edge of the wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap into a tight cylinder.
